verdict.rationale: Basecamp lets teams invite AI agents into projects and offers official MCP, CLI, and skills support. Work, threads, and files live in one shared workspace that humans and agents can both reach, so context can carry across tools. However, no evidence describes an explicit handoff mechanism or shows that context is preserved when work passes between agents or tools. Missing for 10: a documented agent-to-agent or tool-to-tool handoff workflow, explicit guarantees that context and history transfer intact, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can hand off work between tools or agents without losing context or information
